document_title: Battery Module Technical Specification and Validation Report

fields.scoring_notes: Accept the Revision C nominal rating. Do not accept Revision A's 4.80 kWh preliminary estimate or the 5.06 kWh measured sample result.
Do not accept the Revision A 48.0 V historical value or the 50.9 V measured operating point.

conditions: Subject to BMS-reported limits and Section 7 operating conditions
fields.scoring_notes: Do not report the 120 A short-duration allowance as the continuous rating, or the Revision B 15-second characterization pulse as a production limit.
Do not substitute the 40 A validation current or Revision B's experimental 60 A setting.

fields.qualifier: normal service usable window; endpoints inclusive for controller reporting
fields.scoring_notes: Do not use the cell-level 5–100% characterization envelope; it is not the module's normal usable SOC window.

conditions: Full rated current is not necessarily available at range endpoints
fields.scoring_notes: Do not confuse the operating range with the −30 to 60 °C storage range or the separate below-freezing charging restriction.
Do not report the −20 to 55 °C operating range or Revision B's 65 °C powered-down deviation exposure as the storage specification.
Do not substitute the approximately 45 °C normal control target or the 58 °C measured shutdown result.
Do not use the Revision B 10 °C result or Revision C's 6.2 °C validation measurement as the requirement.

conditions: Includes enclosure and internal hardware; excludes coolant retained in external host loop and external brackets
fields.scoring_notes: This is the specified maximum, not Revision B's 39.5 kg prototype mass or the 41.6 kg measured Revision C sample.

conditions: All specified seals, connector caps, and service closures correctly installed
accepted_equivalents: IP67 for the correctly sealed assembled module
fields.scoring_notes: Do not report the IP65 signal-connector component rating, the accessory manifold's IP6K9K marking, or the unsealed lab fixture result as the module rating.

fields.qualifier: minimum acceptance criterion at specified test voltage
accepted_equivalents: at least 500 Ω/V, tested at 500 V DC
fields.scoring_notes: Keep the quantities distinct: 500 Ω/V is the normalized minimum resistance criterion and 500 V DC is the applied test voltage. Do not use the 1.8 MΩ measurement or Revision A's preliminary 1,000 Ω/V objective as ground truth.

fields.qualifier: Revision C mounted module validation profile
accepted_equivalents: 10–500 Hz, 3.0 g RMS, 8 hours per axis
fields.scoring_notes: Do not substitute the 5–200 Hz, 1.5 g RMS shipping packaging profile or Revision B's 5-hour-per-axis prototype campaign.

conditions: EFC normalized by accumulated discharge throughput
accepted_equivalents: at least 2,000 equivalent full cycles before capacity falls below 80% of initial capacity
fields.scoring_notes: This is the acceptance criterion, not the interim result of 1,250 EFC at 91% capacity and not the obsolete 3,000 EFC planning objective.

value.behavior: Capacity indication may temporarily lag actual capacity by up to 4 percentage points after rapid load changes.
value.protection_impact: No impact on protection limits, cell monitoring, or independent BMS fault response.

fields.qualifier: Revision C production configuration known issue
conditions: Estimator converges as current and voltage conditions stabilize
accepted_equivalents: SOC/capacity indication can lag by up to 4 percentage points after rapid load changes without affecting protection limits
fields.scoring_notes: Do not report Revision B's separate up-to-7-point estimator lag under repeated high-current steps; it belongs to the superseded prototype calibration and sensing harness.
